{{Quote|Hadiya killed my grandfather and his eldest son, too -- because they would not bend to her will.|[[Tasha Ryo]]|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 4">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 4|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 4]]</ref>}}
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' held the title of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] and was a member of [[Clan Ryo]]&mdash;a ruling family of [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Shikaakwa]]. During the [[Despot War]], the Baron and his eldest son refused to pledge their allegiance to [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Hadiya]]. As a result, the Despot Queen [[Death/Legends|killed]] them both. His second son, [[Volnos Ryo]], succeeded him as the new Baron of Clan Ryo.
